author: GamingBolt
description:
Survival games are a dime a dozen these days, but there are few titles that manage to truly stand out. Road to Vostok is one such title that immediately impresses with its strong art direction and unique concept. 

Once you look past that cover, there's a whole bunch of compelling merits including but not limited to brutal permadeath mechanics, dynamic systems, and not to forget a sole developer at the helm. 

It's not hard to draw comparisons to GSC Game World's S.T.A.L.K.E.R. series, and Road to Vostok feels like the same game - and it's nothing short of a dream come true for fans of such experiences. With this video, we gush about Road to Vostok and how it might just be the game that S.T.A.L.K.E.R. fans didn't know they wanted.
title: Road To Vostok Looks Like A Dream Come True for STALKER Fans

author: GamingBolt
description:
Crimson Desert isn’t just massive in size; it also hides away an astounding amount of tiny details for its players to find as they make their way across the breadth of Pywell. There’s a lot of stuff just hiding away, waiting for you to stumble on it by accident or through sheer grit and curiosity. 

We channelled all three as we went on one exploring spree after another. The results of our search are interesting, to say the least. Join us and as we discover more about the beauty that Pywel is hiding right under your noses.
title: Crimson Desert - 15 Things You Probably Never Noticed
